units.text: Normally, attached polyps bud off tiny jellyfish, which grow into swimming adults.

units.text: But injury or starvation can send an adult another way.

units.text: Inside, cells reorganize. Some can change their specialized identity: transdifferentiation.

units.text: Life-cycle reversal can happen repeatedly in laboratory cultures.

units.text: The molecular controls are still being studied.

units.text: But predators can still kill it. Reversal isn't guaranteed survival.
